class.name: OcgShapeextendCompositesurface
class.brief_description: Composite surface is represented by a grid of surfaces (patches) connected geometrically. Patches may have different parametrisation ranges, but they should be parametrised in the same manner so that parameter of each patch (u,v) can be converted to global parameter on the whole surface (U,V) with help of linear transformation:
class.description: ! Composite surface is represented by a grid of surfaces ! (patches) connected geometrically. Patches may have different ! parametrisation ranges, but they should be parametrised in ! the same manner so that parameter of each patch (u,v) can be converted ! to global parameter on the whole surface (U,V) with help of linear ! transformation: ! ! for any i,j-th patch ! U = Ui + ( u - uijmin ) * ( Ui+1 - Ui ) / ( uijmax - uijmin ) ! V = Vj + ( v - vijmin ) * ( Vj+1 - Vj ) / ( vijmax - vijmin ) ! ! where ! ! [uijmin, uijmax] * [ vijmin, vijmax] - parametric range of i,j-th patch, ! ! Ui (i=1,..,Nu+1), Vi (j=1,..,Nv+1) - values defining global ! parametrisation by U and V (correspond to points between patches and ! bounds, (Ui,Uj) corresponds to (uijmin,vijmin) on i,j-th patch) and to ! (u(i-1)(j-1)max,v(i-1)(j-1)max) on (i-1),(j-1)-th patch. ! ! Geometrical connectivity is expressed via global parameters: ! S[i,j](Ui+1,V) = S[i+1,j](Ui+1,V) for any i, j, V ! S[i,j](U,Vj+1) = S[i,j+1](U,Vj+1) for any i, j, U ! It is checked with Precision::Confusion() by default. ! ! NOTE 1: This class is inherited from Geom_Surface in order to ! make it more easy to store and deal with it. However, it should ! not be passed to standard methods dealing with geometry since ! this type is not known to them. ! NOTE 2: Not all the inherited methods are implemented, and some are ! implemented not in the full form.

method.name: default
method.description: Empty constructor.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Initializes by a grid of surfaces (calls Init()).

method.name: from_3
method.description: Initializes by a grid of surfaces (calls Init()).

method.name: Init_1
method.description: Initializes by a grid of surfaces. All the Surfaces of the grid must have geometrical connectivity as stated above. If geometrical connectivity is not satisfied, method returns False. However, class is initialized even in that case.

method.name: Init_2
method.description: Initializes by a grid of surfaces with given global parametrisation defined by UJoints and VJoints arrays, each having length equal to number of patches in corresponding direction + 1. Global joint values should be sorted in increasing order. All the Surfaces of the grid must have geometrical connectivity as stated above. If geometrical connectivity is not satisfied, method returns False. However, class is initialized even in that case.

method.name: NbUPatches
method.description: Returns number of patches in U direction.

method.name: NbVPatches
method.description: Returns number of patches in V direction.

method.name: Patch_2
method.description: Returns one surface patch

method.name: Patches
method.description: Returns grid of surfaces

method.name: UJointValues
method.description: Returns the array of U values corresponding to joint points between patches as well as to start and end points, which define global parametrisation of the surface

method.name: VJointValues
method.description: Returns the array of V values corresponding to joint points between patches as well as to start and end points, which define global parametrisation of the surface

method.name: UJointValue
method.description: Returns i-th joint value in U direction (1-st is global Umin, (NbUPatches()+1)-th is global Umax on the composite surface)

method.name: VJointValue
method.description: Returns j-th joint value in V direction (1-st is global Vmin, (NbVPatches()+1)-th is global Vmax on the composite surface)

method.name: SetUJointValues
method.description: Sets the array of U values corresponding to joint points, which define global parametrisation of the surface. Number of values in array should be equal to NbUPatches()+1. All the values should be sorted in increasing order. If this is not satisfied, does nothing and returns False.

method.name: SetVJointValues
method.description: Sets the array of V values corresponding to joint points, which define global parametrisation of the surface Number of values in array should be equal to NbVPatches()+1. All the values should be sorted in increasing order. If this is not satisfied, does nothing and returns False.

method.name: SetUFirstValue
method.description: Changes starting value for global U parametrisation (all other joint values are shifted accordingly)

method.name: SetVFirstValue
method.description: Changes starting value for global V parametrisation (all other joint values are shifted accordingly)

method.name: LocateUParameter
method.description: Returns number of col that contains given (global) parameter

method.name: LocateVParameter
method.description: Returns number of row that contains given (global) parameter

method.name: LocateUVPoint
method.description: Returns number of row and col of surface that contains given point

method.name: Patch_3
method.description: Returns one surface patch that contains given (global) parameters

method.name: Patch_1
method.description: Returns one surface patch that contains given point

method.name: ULocalToGlobal
method.description: Converts local parameter u on patch i,j to global parameter U

method.name: VLocalToGlobal
method.description: Converts local parameter v on patch i,j to global parameter V

method.name: LocalToGlobal
method.description: Converts local parameters uv on patch i,j to global parameters UV

method.name: UGlobalToLocal
method.description: Converts global parameter U to local parameter u on patch i,j

method.name: VGlobalToLocal
method.description: Converts global parameter V to local parameter v on patch i,j

method.name: GlobalToLocal
method.description: Converts global parameters UV to local parameters uv on patch i,j

method.name: GlobalToLocalTransformation
method.description: Computes transformation operator and uFactor descrinbing affine transformation required to convert global parameters on composite surface to local parameters on patch (i,j): uv = ( uFactor, 1. ) X Trsf * UV; NOTE: Thus Trsf contains shift and scale by V, scale by U is stored in uFact. Returns True if transformation is not an identity

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies transformation to all the patches

method.name: Copy
method.description: Returns a copy of the surface

method.name: UReverse
method.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED (does nothing)

method.name: UReversedParameter
method.description: Returns U

method.name: VReverse
method.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED (does nothing)

method.name: VReversedParameter
method.description: Returns V

method.name: Bounds
method.description: Returns the parametric bounds of grid

method.name: IsUClosed
method.description: Returns True if grid is closed in U direction (i.e. connected with Precision::Confusion)

method.name: IsVClosed
method.description: Returns True if grid is closed in V direction (i.e. connected with Precision::Confusion)

method.name: IsUPeriodic
method.description: Returns False

method.name: IsVPeriodic
method.description: Returns False

method.name: UIso
method.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED (returns Null curve)

method.name: VIso
method.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED (returns Null curve)

method.name: Continuity
method.description: returns C0

method.name: IsCNu
method.description: returns True if N <=0

method.name: IsCNv
method.description: returns True if N <=0

method.name: D0
method.description: Computes the point of parameter U,V on the grid.

method.name: D1
method.description: Computes the point P and the first derivatives in the directions U and V at this point.

method.name: D2
method.description: Computes the point P, the first and the second derivatives in the directions U and V at this point.

method.name: D3
method.description: Computes the point P, the first,the second and the third derivatives in the directions U and V at this point.

method.name: DN
method.description: Computes the derivative of order Nu in the direction U and Nv in the direction V at the point P(U, V).

method.name: Value
method.description: Computes the point of parameter pnt on the grid.

method.name: ComputeJointValues
method.description: Computes Joint values according to parameter

method.name: CheckConnectivity
method.description: Checks geometrical connectivity of the patches, including closedness (sets fields muUClosed and myVClosed)
